title: lint: an unguarded condition on owner_id, created_by, updated_by, owning_business_unit_id or queue is accepted though the column can be NULL on a stored row
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mswnWm181XgYcCUag

Follow-up of #33246 (PR #33434), its dev report 6884094895 `open_questions` 1. Seat answer: B, a separate card.

**Measured (engine probe, system context):** a row inserted with a system context holds `created_at` / `updated_at`, and NULL in `owner_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `owning_business_unit_id` and `queue`. `buildNullableFieldIndex` (`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`) leaves every injected column out of the nullable index on purpose, so `os build` (and, after #33434, the publish door) accept `record.owner_id > 'a'` unguarded in a flow or hook condition; on a stored row with NULL there the predicate aborts (flow run fails, hook condition faults).

**First step:** measure what the REST data door stamps for a signed-in user's create (the probe above used a system context), per column and per ownership tier, before deciding. If the door always stamps a column for user writes, the only NULL rows come from system inserts; say whether those reach flows and hooks.

**Candidate fix (to be judged on that evidence):** judge the injected columns the platform does not always populate as nullable at both `os build` and the door; `created_at` / `updated_at` stay never-null. That is a narrowing (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, ADR-0087 entry, measured first-party exposure). If the measurement shows every reachable row is stamped, close with the docblock reasoning made explicit instead.

Related, noted by the same report and not filed separately: a hop leaf through an injected lookup (`record.owner_id.nmae != null`) is judged at neither the build nor the door.

class: b · type: Bug · Grade: p3 (coverage gap, not a false refusal; needs measurement) · domain: spec
